授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
This course is available to all students enrolled at Kyushu University, including degree-seeking and short-term students, as well as those at both undergraduate and graduate levels. If you have any questions about enrolling in this course, please contact the Kyushu University JTW Office at
intlr-jtw@jimu.kyushu-u.ac.jp
.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 社会学的な観点から、現代日本社会の特徴や課題を議論していきます。グローバル化を背景に、国際比較の視座にもとづいた日本社会の理解を深めることを目的としています。外国人留学生にとっては、日本文化社会の初歩的な理解と課題の分析に繋がり、日本人学生にとっては自国の文化社会の見識を国際比較を通じてより多面的に深めることに繋がります。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
This is a quarter-long (eight weeks) course designed to introduce and discuss the main characteristics and issues of contemporary Japanese society from a sociological perspective at an introductory level. The topics covered in this course include age-based social interactions, gender issues, popular culture, work, and health, among others.
Students will not only explore these issues in contemporary Japanese society but also enhance their understanding of their own home country by developing a sociologically-informed, cross-national comparative perspective. This course also encourages Japanese students to enroll to deepen their understanding of key issues in their home culture and society from a global perspective.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Japan; Social Problems; Sociology; Culture; Global
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
This is an all-English course originally designed for international and exchange students. However, domestic students, including those from Japan, are strongly encouraged to enroll. There is no specific level of English proficiency required for formal enrollment in this course.
That said, if you are not a native English speaker, it is important to have a minimum level of English skills to participate effectively and successfully complete the course. We recommend that you have a minimum TOEFL score of 79 (IBT) or an IELTS score of 6.0.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.レポート: Students are required to develop and turn in two sets of take-home essay assignments over the course of the semester - please refer to the course syllabus for more details.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.授業への貢献度: Please note that this course places a strong value on your active participation. Students are required to remain active throughout the semester in class discussions and other learning activities arranged by the instructor. Please refer to the course syllabus for more details.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.出席: Please note that your class attendance will be recorded. The act of class attendances won’t be subjected to any form of reward or credit per se. However, your fourth absence will result in receiving a grade of F (fail) because of the university policy and immigration laws (especially for international students).
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考: You may also find the same course syllabus in the Moodle course site.
